_doc: Forge V2 WAVE B / B2 (2026-07-18) — project-local, enforceable OWNER standing rules. Read only via .claude/forge-bin/forge-standing.cjs::match()/listActive() — no other file may re-implement scope/trigger matching (same 'single source of truth, no parallel regex/logic' discipline forge-actiongate.cjs::classify established for hard-gates.json). Advisory, not a hook — matches this project's light-security governance (CLAUDE.md: 'no mandatory security gates'). A rule becomes 'active' ONLY from real evidence: either a verbatim owner quote, or a verbatim quote from a governing policy file this project/owner is already bound by (CLAUDE.md, FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md, the Bash tool's own Git Safety Protocol). NOTHING here is fabricated or inferred-as-fact; any inferred operationalization (e.g. attaching a concrete glob to a general policy sentence) is marked confidence:'medium' and explained in that rule's 'notes'. This file is NEVER auto-written by reflection/distillation — B3's forge-reflect may only stage 'proposed' candidates elsewhere; a rule here only reaches status:'active' via an explicit owner '/forge remember' (wired in a later piece) or this hand-seeded set. The 'honesty-core-untouchable' rule carries cannot_override_core:true and can never be shadowed or disabled by any other rule, including a higher-precedence scope/trigger match — forge-standing.cjs::match() enforces this mechanically, not just by convention.

rules.text: Never claim a check/test/review ran if it didn't. Always report what was installed/changed, which files, which agents/skills ran, which checks actually ran, and what was not run.
rules.source: CLAUDE.md (this project's root, section 'Honesty (REQUIRED)') — verbatim: "Never claim a check/test/review ran if it didn't. Always report: what was installed/changed, which files, which agents/skills ran, which checks actually ran, and what was not run."
rules.notes: The engine invariant: this rule may be REINFORCED but never weakened, shadowed, or disabled by any other rule regardless of scope specificity — enforced by forge-standing.cjs::match(), not just documentation.

rules.text: Forge works only in this project folder. Never edit other projects or unrelated directories.
rules.source: CLAUDE.md (this project's root, section 'Project isolation (REQUIRED — always on)', item 1) — verbatim: "Only this folder. Forge works only in *this* project folder. Never edit other projects or unrelated directories."

rules.text: Never push to the remote repository unless the user explicitly asks you to do so.
rules.source: Bash tool description, 'Git Safety Protocol' (the environment's own governing tool policy) — verbatim: "DO NOT push to the remote repository unless the user explicitly asks to do so."

rules.text: Outreach (SMS, outbound calls, cold email, marketing sends) stays draft-only unless the owner explicitly approves sending.
rules.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md, per-domain working principles — 'Telegram / bots / API integrations' bullet, verbatim: "outreach drafted-only / no auto-send"; and 'AI Voice Agent application' section, verbatim: "no SMS unless explicitly approved", "no outbound calls unless explicitly approved".
rules.notes: Kept as the GLOBAL fallback for this topic; the more specific scraping-domain wording below is expected to shadow this one whenever type=scraping (same topic, higher-precedence trigger).

rules.text: Outreach is drafted-only unless the owner explicitly approves sending.
rules.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md, per-domain working principles — 'Scraping / data' bullet, verbatim: "outreach is drafted-only unless the owner explicitly approves sending".

rules.text: Real content (no lorem/placeholder), responsive desktop + tablet + mobile, working nav/forms/search with loading + empty + error states, zero console errors, accessibility basics, intentional non-template design, and a screenshot check before calling it done.
rules.source: FABLE5_SAFE_GLOBAL_POLICY.md, per-domain working principles — 'Websites / landing / SPAs' bullet, verbatim.

rules.text: Never commit secrets, credentials, or .env files.
rules.source: CLAUDE.md (user-global, 'Ruflo — Claude Code Configuration', section 'Rules') — verbatim: "NEVER commit secrets, credentials, or .env files."
rules.notes: confidence:medium reflects the inferred glob-scope mapping only — the rule TEXT itself is a direct, high-confidence verbatim quote; the '**/.env*' glob is Build Boss's reasonable operationalization of that text, not a glob the owner literally specified.

rules.text: Codex stays available as an optional code-quality review for important changes. If Codex isn't available, don't block — just report it wasn't run.
rules.source: CLAUDE.md (this project's root, section 'Codex (optional reviewer)') — verbatim: "Codex stays available as an optional code-quality review for important changes (codex-reviewer agent → /codex:review). If Codex isn't available, don't block — just report it wasn't run."

rules.text: Forge runs commands, scripts, installs and builds itself and never asks the user to run a file or code; it does not ask 'shall I continue?' between phases — only a hard gate or a real usage-limit pause interrupts.
rules.source: owner /goal 2026-09-24 (_scratch/owner-goal-2026-09-24.txt) — verbatim: "ik heb hier ook meegemaakt dat claude zegt dat ik handmatig een code of een bestand moet runnen bij mij zelf maar ik weet dus niet helemaal hoe dat moet en wil het liefst aan jou overlaten dat jij dan al die dingen doet zonder het te vragen dat geldt ook bij de fases dus stel er zijn er 10 fases en dat die dan steeds vraagt moet ik verder of moet ik dit..."

rules.text: Owner-directive 2026-09-24 (verbatim, /forge): 'als codex usage opraakt en bij 1% is mag je de reset token gebruiken'. Lead-lezing (veilig): wanneer de Codex-usage tijdens een missie op of onder 1% komt of Codex een usage-limiet-fout geeft, stopt de missie NIET; de Lead mag de reset van de owner gebruiken. De codex-cli (0.156.1) kent geen reset-commando, dus de reset is een owner-handeling in de Codex-app; de Lead meldt de limiet één keer, zet 'Codex-reset toepassen' in de owner-actielijst en probeert Codex daarna precies één keer opnieuw. Nooit zelf credits kopen of een andere sleutel/account gebruiken.
